issues.quote: revenue rising 18.7% to $211.9 billion from $198.3 billion in fiscal 2022

data.summary: All the dollar figures match Microsoft's reported FY2023 and FY2022 results as I know them (no source documents were available), and the 0.5% net income decline holds on unrounded figures (about -0.52%). However, the revenue growth rate is wrong: it is about 6.9%, not 18.7%.
